_help: How the automation recognises which marketplace a Payment Received belongs to.
A payment is matched when ANY keyword appears as a whole word in ANY of 'fields_to_search'.
A payment matching NO marketplace, or MORE THAN ONE, is never used.
Allowed fields: customer, reference, notes, deposit_to.
Built from the real Zoho customer names (2026-10-06) and confirmed by the user:
US = 'Amazon US' only; 'EBAY US' / 'Walmart US' / 'Shopify US' belong to eBay / Walmart / Shopify.
Deliberately matched by NO rule (never used): 'Amazon DE Fee Reversal', 'Souq.com'.
